versions.changelog: Configure one-shot sync with --conversations and --recent, including conversation-only discovery with --recent 0. Pin gmcli v1.2.0; archive queries remain read-only. Thanks to Don Petry (@don-petry) for PR #10.
Pair with gmcli auth using automatic browser sign-in; no cookie file or developer tools required. Pin gmcli v1.1.0 and retain the OpenClaw 2026.8.1 minimum.
Replace QR pairing with Google Account emoji authentication; require OpenClaw 2026.8.1 or newer; enforce runtime preflight and use evidence-based archive health.
Add send readiness diagnostics, QR PNG pairing output, current Google Messages protocol library support, and strict real-SIM send metadata handling.
Cache Google Messages send settings for outbound SMS readiness, add doctor send-readiness diagnostics, and document the new fields for OpenClaw.
Lead with search and summarization examples, add local-first trust signals, and improve ClawHub discovery copy.
Clarify that the ClawHub archive playbook uses read-only queries by default without claiming gmcli is read-only.
Publish the canonical gmcli repository skill and graduate from alpha.
Publish the canonical gmcli repository skill and graduate from alpha.

Fix public rendering and storefront positioning. Keeps the Google Messages Local Archive name, preserves explicit gmcli Go installer metadata, and replaces raw angle-bracket placeholders so ClawHub renders examples correctly instead of treating them as HTML tags.

Initial release under the corrected Google Messages Local Archive name. Repositions the ClawHub listing for end users as a read-only OpenClaw skill over a private local gmcli archive, and adds metadata.openclaw.install so fresh OpenClaw installs can surface a Go installer for gmcli.
